_about: Taxon authorities (author(s), year) for species whose page needs one and whose reviewed account does not give it. Each is the authority used by The Reptile Database (https://reptile-database.reptarium.cz/); brackets mean the species was first described in another genus. A reviewed account's own 'authority' always wins. Species pages and region pages show these instead of a run-time Wikidata guess, and wd.js only adds a person from Wikidata when the surname and year match.
titanoboa-cerrejonensis: Head, Bloch, Hastings, Bourque, Cadena, Herrera, Polly & Jaramillo, 2009
